problem: Website quality lacked one canonical cross-browser screenshot assurance spanning responsive layouts, real interactions, exact PR previews and daily production.
root_cause: Existing checks were fragmented and primarily Chromium-oriented; screenshot evidence and Firefox/WebKit behavior were not one fail-closed contract.
decision: Use the existing website delivery lane with an exact Netlify PR-preview gate plus a daily production sitemap sweep and critical Chromium/Firefox/WebKit screenshot matrix.
prevention: PRs test the exact deploy-preview candidate.
Daily production sweeps all sitemap routes on mobile and desktop.
Critical route families render in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit across mobile/tablet/desktop.
Menu and language interactions are exercised.
Failures retain screenshots and report artifacts for 30 days.
